text.tspan: Notes to trigger the kit’s sounds can be played on drum pads, laid
out as a series of 4 x 4 pads, each cluster controlling the sound
and each pad controlling the velocity.
This is available by pressing [KEYBOARD] when in Kit View
The kit sounds are mapped across the pad zones with velocity per individual pad.
The drum pad zones are represented by the colour.
The Drum pad size can be adjusted from the default 4x4 range.
